title: PFIA Authorized-Investment Condition Catalogue (Schedule B v2)
authority_label: Tex. Gov't Code ch. 2256, Subchapter A

semantics.unit: One condition = one requirement a policy can state, contradict or omit independently.

states.CONFORMING: Policy states the condition at the statutory level.
states.STRICTER: Policy states a narrower term (lower cap, higher floor, better rating, smaller permitted set). Conforms under Sec. 2256.024.
states.BY_REFERENCE: Satisfied by an incorporation clause in scope (ADR 0007).
states.SILENT: Policy does not address the condition. Never a conformity finding; the statute binds regardless.
states.CONTRADICTED: Policy states a term the statute does not permit.
states.UNKNOWN: Extracted fact missing or unparseable. Never resolved to a pass or a fail (ADR 0005).

semantics.conformity: Statutory band. An instrument is DEFICIENT if any active condition is CONTRADICTED, UNKNOWN if any is UNKNOWN and none is CONTRADICTED, else CONFORMING. The finding names every contradicted condition.
semantics.division_of_labour: The model extracts facts (value, unit, stated, contradicted, span). All comparisons are made in code; the model never decides whether a term is stricter or looser.
semantics.anti_patterns: Retired as scoring inputs for this schedule. Where kept, they are extraction hints confined to the instrument's clause window, never document-wide.
semantics.status: Categorical (ADR 0010). An instrument is CONFLICTS if any active condition is CONTRADICTED, REVIEW_REQUIRED if any is UNKNOWN or APPLICABILITY_UNRESOLVED and none is CONTRADICTED, otherwise ALIGNED. Conditions the policy does not restate are reported as NOT_RESTATED; they never change the instrument status, because the statute binds regardless. No weights, fractions or indices.
semantics.extraction_cues: `cues`, `outside_cues` and `contradiction_cues` are extraction hints: examples shown to the model and the only signals the offline stand-in uses. They never decide a state; the evaluator compares the extracted fact.
